name: letterncms/wilgendaal
description: A Flemish city's website, in Dutch, built for accessibility: a home page that opens on the town and what you want to arrange, 46 services under 10 themes with cost, term and what to bring, an A to Z, news, events, participation, the council, locations with opening hours and maps, notices with tagged PDFs, forms, and an accessibility statement in the Flemish format.
